name: 내루미
motifs: A thick pink tail becomes a curved layered sash of fabric and slim plates behind her waist; yellow curved lines and concentric circles become enamel trim across pink armor. A long tongue is abstracted as a rounded pink ribbon collar, never an animal tongue or held object.
light: In a pastel stone plaza, a poised adult woman faces the camera in a front three-quarter stance, both open empty hands separated beside her hips. Pink enamel slim armor with warm yellow curved trim and a sweeping pink waist sash. Full body, feet and hair with margins.
casual: At a bright retro ice-cream workshop, using two widely separated hands to place colorful berries onto a tall parfait on the counter. Midday soft skylight, chrome and blush tile. Face and both hands entirely visible.
Opaque yellow square-neck sleeveless fitted top and high-waisted pink shorts with a short waist apron. Bare arms and shoulders, small curved ribbon earring; no armor.

Walking along an empty sunlit sandy beach carrying nothing, one arm gently swinging and the other open beside her hip. Wind ripples a narrow waist wrap, clear morning turquoise surf. Entire body and both hands visible.

Secure fully lined coral-pink two-piece swimsuit with broad yellow straps, structured opaque cups and high-waisted bottoms, a small airy sarong tied at the side. Bare midriff arms and legs, tiny ring pendant.

On a cushioned window bench in a quiet attic at rainy blue hour, one knee raised while examining a plain vinyl record held at its separated left and right outer edges. Torso and pelvis rotate together toward camera, warm lamp and rain outside. Both hands fully seen.
Opaque cream sleeveless fitted knit vest with deep secure neckline, pink wrap mini skirt with yellow seam piping. Bare shoulders arms and legs; tiny circular hairclip.

comparison.scope: Bellossom plan read; six Exeggcute and Cubone casual images visually compared. Earlier plans in this batch also compared.
